title: The Deligne–Drinfeld conjecture

result.label: The Deligne–Drinfeld conjecture
result.statement: Proves that the rational Grothendieck–Teichmüller Lie algebra, with the Ihara bracket, is freely generated by one element in each odd weight 3, 5, 7, …, resolving the Deligne–Drinfeld conjecture.
